g.text: Passive optical network | Topology at a glance
A typical OLT-to-customer path; splitter staging depends on the network design
Follow the numbered path for physical connectivity. Bidirectional arrows represent upstream and downstream service.
Passive splitters need no powered outside-plant electronics; single-stage designs can omit the secondary split.
